Choir Shade

The Noon King

Vesper, the Unending Moment
The Vespersong, grown a face. A clock that ate the sun. It does not want anything except for this to never end.
Hour Hand
Slow. Inevitable. It has been coming toward you since the moment you were born.
Minute Hand
Quick. Restless. Never where it was a moment ago.

The kite climbs into air that has not moved in forty years...
"Hush," says the Bell, in a voice like an empty cathedral.

Confetti swirls into the shape of a dancer!
"And one-two-three, and one-two-three, and—"
The dark opens. It has been hungry for a very long time.
Shadows peel off the Hungry Dark and run on four legs!
The Hungry Dark opens wider. It wants whoever is weakest.
"I don't want to hurt you, Wren. I never have. Please — let me show you."
"Sing with me, children. Just once more."
Cassian hums the first bar of the Vespersong. The air forgets how to move.
Cassian lifts his hands. The first verse of the Vespersong gathers in the air...
"Look at it, Wren. The sun, whole — for as long as I can hold it."
The seven shards blaze into a crown of noon.
The shards are tearing loose! Light can reach the man inside the sun!
A shard tears free and circles the King.
The King lifts the broken sun to its highest point...
The Hour and Minute Hands cross before Vesper's face. It is shielded!
A hand falls still. Vesper's face is open!
Vesper's hands spin backwards. Every clock in Evernoon begins to unwind — its weaknesses turn with it!
Vesper, the Last Second
"STAY," says every clock at once. Vesper rewinds itself — but dawn-colored cracks are showing through!
The last toll sounds. Someone's time is running out.
A hand reassembles itself out of the ticking.
Both hands creep toward XII...
Vesper begins to hum a lullaby. Stay. Stay. Stay...
The clock-sun swells. It is about to strike noon forever...
